meta.title: Sync Task
meta.summary: Synchronize a Medux task with its upstream provider. Returns the latest status, progress, billing, errors, and result references for on-demand task refreshes.

hero.title: Sync Task
hero.summary: Synchronize a Medux task with its upstream provider. Returns the latest status, progress, billing, errors, and result references for on-demand task refreshes.

endpoint_summary.summary: Pull the latest provider-side state and return the synced local task.

auth_requirements.title: Auth Requirements
items: Authentication is required via Authorization header.

preconditions.title: Preconditions
items: Requires a task_id created by a clone, generate, or process request.
Use this when you want to refresh task state outside the default polling loop.
